snippet.title: PlayStation - Complete Onside Soccer (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Choose from any of the top teams in the four European leagues (English, Italian, German and French) and then decide where your strengths lie. Are you management material or would you prefer to do your team talking on the pitch? Whatever the scenario, you have complete control. Transfer deals, friendlies, training tactics and cup ties are just a small part of what ONSIDE is all about.
